classes.name: Vanguard
classes.promise: Guard, counters, formation play, and dependable melee.
classes.armor: Heavy plate with broad shoulders and a readable shield silhouette.

talents.name: Brace the Line
talents.description: Guard costs less Stamina and resists forced movement

talents.name: Shield Wake
talents.description: a guarded hit empowers the next Shield strike with a short shockwave

talents.name: Interpose
talents.description: rush to an ally and receive their next direct hit

talents.name: Unbroken Guard
talents.description: a Perfect Guard restores Stamina and Guard stability

talents.name: Bastion Field
talents.description: allies immediately behind the Vanguard take less frontal ranged damage

talents.name: Living Fortress
talents.description: enter a slow fortified stance with immense Guard and protective pulses

talents.name: Rallying Cry
talents.description: briefly improve nearby allies' movement and Guard recovery

talents.name: Claim the Ground
talents.description: plant a banner that strengthens allies inside its area

talents.name: Shared Resolve
talents.description: protecting a wounded ally grants both Heroes temporary Defense

talents.name: Formation Step
talents.description: moving near allies gives the group slow-resistance and stability

talents.name: Last Line
talents.description: the banner pulses a shield when an ally first falls below critical health

talents.name: Crowned Vanguard
talents.description: the banner follows the Vanguard and strengthens every formation effect

talents.name: Measured Counter
talents.description: the first attack after a Perfect Guard deals bonus stagger

talents.name: Sweeping Reprisal
talents.description: a counterattack may strike enemies on both sides

talents.name: Hampering Blow
talents.description: a precise hit reduces enemy attack speed instead of unequipping gear

talents.name: Iron Tempo
talents.description: alternating Guard and attack steadily accelerates recovery

talents.name: Judgment Counter
talents.description: countering a telegraphed Elite action exposes its weakness

talents.name: Perfect Retort
talents.description: a Perfect Guard may immediately reset one counter action

classes.name: Ravager
classes.promise: Committed heavy swings, stagger, armor breaking, and controlled risk.
classes.armor: Heavy or reinforced medium armor with a weight-forward silhouette.

talents.name: Rising Heat
talents.description: consecutive committed hits build temporary attack speed

talents.name: Relentless Advance
talents.description: heavy attacks resist minor interruption while moving forward

talents.name: Pain into Power
talents.description: taking damage empowers the next fully charged swing

talents.name: Fury Unbound
talents.description: spending maximum Heat grants a brief burst of movement and recovery

talents.name: No Surrender
talents.description: once per encounter, a would-be stagger instead fills Heat

talents.name: Heart of Thunder
talents.description: maximum Heat transforms heavy attacks into chaining thunderous impacts

talents.name: Splinter Armor
talents.description: charged hits apply a stacking Defense reduction

talents.name: Crushing Arc
talents.description: downward attacks damage shields, constructs, and breakable terrain more strongly

talents.name: Faultline
talents.description: a ground strike sends a short rupture along the platform

talents.name: Sundered Guard
talents.description: breaking Guard briefly prevents its full recovery

talents.name: Ruinous Impact
talents.description: striking an exposed Elite creates a party-wide damage opening

talents.name: Worldbreaker
talents.description: the next charged attack creates three sequential faultline eruptions

talents.name: Heavy Hands
talents.description: Two-Handed Weapon reach and stagger increase slightly

talents.name: Anchored Swing
talents.description: charging an attack resists pull and knockback

talents.name: Giant's Reach
talents.description: the final strike of a combo gains a much wider arc

talents.name: Aftershock
talents.description: fully charged hits repeat a weaker impact after a delay

talents.name: Mountain Step
talents.description: a short armored step passes through lesser creatures

talents.name: Titan Form
talents.description: temporarily enlarge weapon arcs, stability, and environmental break power

classes.name: Ranger
classes.promise: Ranged pressure, weak-point shots, traps, and mobile fieldcraft.
classes.armor: Medium leather and light mail with compact, practical shapes.

talents.name: Patient Aim
talents.description: remaining still briefly improves the next projectile's precision

talents.name: Piercing Shot
talents.description: a charged projectile passes through one additional target

talents.name: Marked Weakness
talents.description: hitting a telegraphed weak point marks it for the party

talents.name: Trueflight
talents.description: long-range attacks lose less damage and accuracy

talents.name: Thread the Needle
talents.description: striking through a small opening guarantees a critical weak-point hit

talents.name: Horizon Shot
talents.description: fire a screen-spanning shot that gains power for every marked target crossed

talents.name: Quick Vault
talents.description: vaulting over a creature reloads or readies the next ranged attack

talents.name: Snareline
talents.description: place a visible line trap that roots the first lesser creature crossing it

talents.name: Smokeleaf Roll
talents.description: a dodge leaves a brief concealment cloud

talents.name: High Ground
talents.description: attacks from above gain stagger and trap damage

talents.name: Trail Without Trace
talents.description: movement no longer triggers ordinary environmental snares

talents.name: Every Road Is Mine
talents.description: deploy two traps at once and gain a reset when either is used cleverly

talents.name: Gentle Approach
talents.description: calm eligible neutral creatures and begin Companion bonds

talents.name: Companion Call
talents.description: summon one bonded creature with a simple support action

talents.name: Shared Senses
talents.description: the Companion reveals nearby tracks, Hidden Zone clues, and weak points

talents.name: Protective Instinct
talents.description: Hero and Companion shield one another when either is threatened

talents.name: Pack Tactics
talents.description: marked targets take coordinated attacks from both partners

talents.name: Legendary Bond
talents.description: unlock the Companion's signature action and prevent its first defeat each encounter

classes.name: Duelist
classes.promise: Two one-handed weapons, evasive footwork, bleeds, and precise counters.
classes.armor: Light leather and cloth with deliberate asymmetry.

talents.name: Crosscut
talents.description: alternating Main Hand and Off Hand attacks adds a crossing finisher

talents.name: Opposed Edges
talents.description: using two different Weapon Families grants both a small signature bonus

talents.name: Twin Parry
talents.description: a precisely timed paired block can answer attacks from either side

talents.name: Flowing Combination
talents.description: switching hands extends the combo instead of restarting it

talents.name: Mirror Blades
talents.description: a critical strike empowers the opposite hand's next action

talents.name: Hundred-Step Finale
talents.description: unleash a rapid finisher whose pattern reflects the equipped pair

talents.name: Quickstep
talents.description: gain a short low-cooldown evasive step

talents.name: Passing Cut
talents.description: Quickstep through an enemy to deliver a light crossing strike

talents.name: Perfect Distance
talents.description: attacks at the edge of weapon reach gain precision

talents.name: Airborne Feint
talents.description: redirect once in the air and conceal the landing direction

talents.name: Untouchable Rhythm
talents.description: successive near-misses shorten Quickstep recovery

talents.name: Dance Between Raindrops
talents.description: briefly chain Quicksteps while every successful evade empowers the finale

talents.name: False Opening
talents.description: intentionally delay a strike to provoke an early enemy response

talents.name: Pommel Trick
talents.description: a close interruption deals high stagger but low damage

talents.name: Bleeding Nick
talents.description: precision hits apply a short non-stacking bleed

talents.name: Disarming Flourish
talents.description: reduce a creature's damage or suppress one weapon action; never steals player gear

talents.name: Final Feint
talents.description: once per combo, cancel a finisher into the opposite hand

talents.name: Curtain Call
talents.description: marked feints collapse at once, repeating part of the damage they enabled

classes.name: Arcanist
classes.promise: Elemental projectiles, zones, control, and fragile magical burst.
classes.armor: Layered elemental robes with large readable sleeves.

talents.name: Kindle
talents.description: repeated fire hits build a small Burning effect

talents.name: Searing Sigil
talents.description: place a delayed fire rune on terrain

talents.name: Flame Step
talents.description: dash through a short flame path without taking contact damage

talents.name: Hungry Flame
talents.description: fire zones grow when they consume another elemental effect

talents.name: Phoenix Script
talents.description: once per encounter, critical health triggers a fiery escape and shield

talents.name: Living Inferno
talents.description: combine active fire zones into a moving elemental storm

talents.name: Rime Dart
talents.description: frost projectiles progressively slow lesser creatures

talents.name: Crystal Ward
talents.description: form a breakable ice barrier on a platform

talents.name: Freeze Line
talents.description: draw a short freezing path across the ground

talents.name: Shattercraft
talents.description: breaking the Arcanist's ice effects launches safe fragments outward

talents.name: Winter Room
talents.description: create a large zone that slows actions and projectiles

talents.name: Still World
talents.description: briefly freeze lesser creatures and suspend Elite telegraphs without cancelling them

talents.name: Spark Chain
talents.description: lightning jumps once to a nearby marked target

talents.name: Gale Lift
talents.description: create an updraft for the Arcanist and allies

talents.name: Thunder Mark
talents.description: delayed lightning strikes a target after an obvious count

talents.name: Blink Current
talents.description: teleport a short distance along an active lightning connection

talents.name: Tempest Crown
talents.description: orbiting sparks answer nearby spell casts

talents.name: Skybreak
talents.description: call a storm column that repeatedly lifts, chains, and grounds targets

classes.name: Warden
classes.promise: Radiance protection, Gloam curses, life transfer, or an Eclipse balance.
classes.armor: Asymmetric polarity robes with paired luminous and umbral details.

talents.name: Kindle Light
talents.description: healing or shielding leaves a small lingering glow

talents.name: Mending Ray
talents.description: channel a beam that heals an ally or harms a corrupted creature

talents.name: Halo Ward
talents.description: place a circular barrier that absorbs one heavy hit

talents.name: Revealing Flare
talents.description: expose concealed creatures, traps, and Gloam effects

talents.name: Sanctuary
talents.description: create a zone of healing and control resistance

talents.name: Second Sunrise
talents.description: once per encounter, restore a recently defeated ally with partial health

talents.name: Gloam Bolt
talents.description: damaging spells leave a short shadow vulnerability

talents.name: Withering Mark
talents.description: reduce a target's outgoing damage and healing

talents.name: Shadebind
talents.description: pin a lesser creature's shadow to the ground

talents.name: Life Siphon
talents.description: transfer a portion of damage dealt into healing for the weakest nearby ally

talents.name: Night Mantle
talents.description: cloak the party from ordinary creature detection until they attack

talents.name: Long Eclipse
talents.description: spread active Gloam marks and extend their final tick

talents.name: Twilight Attunement
talents.description: alternating Radiance and Gloam reduces the second spell's cost

talents.name: Balanced Weave
talents.description: each school strengthens the next spell of the other school

talents.name: Dusk Exchange
talents.description: move one removable harmful effect from an ally onto a valid enemy

talents.name: Convergence
talents.description: overlapping Radiance and Gloam zones create a Twilight field

talents.name: Equinox
talents.description: keeping both Attunements balanced improves cast speed and stability

talents.name: Eclipse Incarnate
talents.description: temporarily let every Warden spell count as both schools for interactions
